app.name: Nabd Clinic
app.tagline: Run your clinic calmly and clearly

login.title: Welcome to the demo
login.subtitle: Pick the role you want to try. No sign-up needed.
login.receptionistDesc: Appointments, calendar, patients and every visit's status.
login.doctorDesc: Today's patient queue, visit notes and your schedule.
login.failedDescription: Something went wrong while starting the demo session. Please try again.
login.note: All data is fictional and stays on your device.
login.brandHeadline: The whole clinic day on one screen
login.brandBody: Book appointments, track arrivals and read simple reports: a complete journey from first login to last visit.
login.highlight2: A clear path for every appointment, booking to done
login.resetDone: The demo was reset: appointments, patients, services and notifications are back to their original state. Your language and theme are unchanged.

shell.searchPlaceholder: Search patients and appointments, or type a command…

palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Search a patient, appointment or doctor, or type a command…
palette.noResultsHint: Try another word or clear the search.

dashboard.title: Today

upcoming.title: Next appointments
upcoming.subtitle: Still to be seen today
upcoming.emptyDescription: Every appointment today is done or cancelled. You can book a new one.

dashboard.errorDescription: Something went wrong while reading the demo data. Please try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDescription: Change the interface language at any time. Direction switches automatically.
settings.themeDescription: Light is comfortable on bright screens, dark suits low-light rooms.
settings.resetDescription: Clears everything you did in the demo (appointments, patients, services, edits, notifications) and restores the original data. Your language, theme and sidebar layout stay as they are.
settings.resetConfirmDescription: This clears all appointments, patients and services you added or changed, the notifications and the current session, and restores the original data. These stay: your language, theme and sidebar layout.
settings.aboutBody: Nabd Clinic is a demo by KHENOV. All names, numbers and appointments are fictional, and there is no real server: everything stays on your device.

panel.missingDescription: This appointment was deleted or changed.
panel.locked: This appointment is finished and read-only: its time, doctor and service can no longer change.
panel.noShowHint: “No-show” becomes available once the appointment time has ended.

cancel.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The patient called to postpone

delete.title: Delete this appointment?
delete.description: {{patient}}'s appointment at {{time}} will be deleted. You can undo right after.

form.descriptionNew: Pick the patient and a time to book in one go.
form.descriptionEdit: Change anything, or move the appointment to another time or doctor.
form.patientNoResults: No patient matches this name or number
form.nameRequired: Enter the patient's name (at least 2 characters).
form.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Egyptian mobile number: 11 digits starting with 010, 011, 012 or 015.
form.phoneDuplicate: This number belongs to another patient.
form.quickAddFailed: Could not add the patient. Please try again.
form.noSlotsDescription: The doctor is fully booked on this day. Try another day or another doctor.
form.needTime: Pick an available time to continue.
form.fixConflict: This time has a conflict: pick another time.

conflict.doctor_overlap: {{doctor}} already has an appointment from {{from}} to {{to}}.
conflict.patient_overlap: {{patient}} already has an appointment from {{from}} to {{to}}.
conflict.outside_hours: This time is outside {{doctor}}'s working hours ({{from}} – {{to}}).
conflict.past_time: That time has passed. The earliest time available today is {{earliest}}.
conflict.past_day: That day has passed. Pick today or a later day.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.emptyDescription: There are no appointments in this period. Book one with the button above.
calendar.errorDescription: Something went wrong while reading the appointments. Please try again.
calendar.moveHint: Drag an appointment to move it, or open it and choose “Edit or reschedule”. Finished appointments (done, cancelled, no-show) are read-only.

toast.failed: Could not complete the action. Please try again.
toast.notFound: The appointment or patient was not found.
toast.pastTime: Appointments can't be booked or moved to a time that has passed.
toast.inactiveDoctor: This doctor is switched off and isn't taking new bookings.
toast.locked: This appointment is finished (done, cancelled or no-show) and can no longer change.

access.title: This screen isn't available for your role
access.description: This screen belongs to another role. You are signed in as “{{role}}”.

validation.name: Enter the name in Arabic and English (at least 2 characters each).
validation.age: Age must be a number from 0 to 120.
validation.hours: Working hours must be between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM, at least one hour long.
validation.duration: Pick a duration between 15 and 180 minutes.
validation.price: Enter a valid price (a number from 0 to 100000).
validation.tooLong: The note is longer than 200 characters.

patients.title: Patients
patients.emptyDescription: Add the first patient and start booking.
patients.noResultsDescription: Try another name, or clear the search and filter.
patients.errorDescription: Something went wrong while reading the data. Please try again.
patients.notFoundDescription: This patient was deleted or the link is wrong.
patients.deleteDescription: {{name}} will be removed from the list. No appointments are linked to them.
patients.deleteWithHistory: {{name}} will be removed together with their past appointments ({{count}}). This can't be undone.
patients.blockedDescription: {{name}} has {{count}} upcoming appointments. Cancel or move them first, then try again.

form.description: Contact details only, no medical information.

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.subtitle: Specialties, working hours and today's load.

doctors.notFoundDescription: The link is wrong or the doctor doesn't exist.

form.description: Name, specialty and working hours. Booking follows these hours.
form.activeHint: When switched off, the doctor won't appear in new bookings. Existing appointments stay as they are.
form.inUse: Can't save: {{count}} upcoming appointments would fall outside the new hours or no longer match the new specialty. Move or cancel them first.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Duration and price in EGP for every service.

form.description: Name, specialty, duration and price in EGP.
form.inUse: Duration and specialty are locked because {{count}} upcoming appointments use this service. You can still change the name and price.
